metadata.description: Marketplace for study-kit — an agent and skill bundle that helps an expert come up to working speed in an adjacent field

plugins.name: study-kit
plugins.description: A bundle of procedures for building a textbook and a course of study for one particular person: learner intake, a graded source index, curriculum design, textbook authoring, a revision loop driven by the learner's questions, and publication. The subject is not built in — the kit asks the learner what to teach.
